priorityList: Summon your ghoul with Raise Dead before combat starts.
Maintain Virulent Plague on all targets using Outbreak if it has fewer than 3 ticks remaining.
Cast Army of the Dead when your main cooldowns are ready, ideally with 30+ Runic Power.
Use Dark Transformation while Army of the Dead is active or whenever it is off cooldown.
Place Death and Decay (or Desecrate) if it is not already active on the ground.
If Festering Scythe is talented, use Festering Strike to maintain the Festering Scythe debuff.
Cast Epidemic to spend Runic Power if you have fewer than 2 Runes available or a Sudden Doom proc.
Use Festering Strike if you have zero stacks of Lesser Ghoul Ready.
Cast Scourge Strike whenever you have at least one stack of Lesser Ghoul Ready to summon a ghoul.
Use Putrefy as a high priority for AoE damage and San'layn talent synergy.
Cast Soul Reaper on targets below 35% health.
Use Epidemic as your primary Runic Power spender in all 4+ target scenarios.
Use Death Coil only as a fallback spender if Epidemic priority conditions are not met.
Activate offensive Trinkets and Racial abilities (like Blood Fury or Berserking) during Dark Transformation.
Request or use Power Infusion when Dark Transformation or Army of the Dead is active.
